title: T-pillar at Çavuştepe, visited with Robert Schoch

tellings.quote: that shavo Tepe it's made out of balt now now that's Robert shock right there uh we were all there just recently

plain: At Çavuştepe in Turkey stands a T-shaped stone pillar made of basalt, and Matt LaCroix, who talks on the show about very ancient sites, says he went to see it recently with a group that included Robert Schoch, whom he points out in an image ("that's Robert Schoch right there"). LaCroix raises it on an episode about something big happening around 12,000 BC, as one more site he takes to be part of a lost early chapter of human history.
